what: a preview of one hypothesis on real closed hourly candles: a demonstration on past data, not a forecast and not evidence

proposal.statement: BTC bounces within four hours after the hourly RSI is below 35

assumptions.text: the hourly RSI of BTC falls below 35 from time to time
an oversold reading is followed by a bounce within four hours

preview.label: demonstration, not evidence: made on past data, which a model may have seen; no forecast was committed
